head_commit.message:
fix: fix symlinked writable roots in sandbox policies (#14674)

## Summary
- normalize effective readable, writable, and unreadable sandbox roots
after resolving special paths so symlinked roots use canonical runtime
paths
- add a protocol regression test for a symlinked writable root with a
denied child and update protocol expectations to canonicalized effective
paths
- update macOS seatbelt tests to assert against effective normalized
roots produced by the shared policy helpers

## Testing
- just fmt
- cargo test -p codex-protocol
- cargo test -p codex-core explicit_unreadable_paths_are_excluded_
- cargo clippy -p codex-protocol -p codex-core --tests -- -D warnings

## Notes
- This is intended to fix the symlinked TMPDIR bind failure in
bubblewrap described in #14672.
Fixes #14672

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): route app-server thread events safely

Track which threads are app-server-managed so legacy notifications
only feed that path, and keep direct-core threads on their existing
`next_event()` listener pipeline.

Exit fatally if the app-server event stream closes while managed
threads still depend on it, and add regression tests for both the
legacy-event filter and stream-closure behavior.

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): ignore stale skills list failures

Check `skills/list` response staleness before treating a failed
response as fatal in `App::handle_skills_list_loaded`.

This keeps delayed failures from older generations or cwd requests from
tearing down the app loop, and adds regression coverage for the stale
error case.

Bound guardian startup with review timeout

Start the guardian review deadline before the reusable-subagent manager lock and carry it through subagent spawn, history reset, network approval copying, and turn submission. Keep timeout-triggered cleanup non-blocking and heap-box the heavy timeout-wrapped futures so the prompt-cache reuse test does not overflow its stack.

fix: fix symlinked writable roots in sandbox policies (#14674)

## Summary
- normalize effective readable, writable, and unreadable sandbox roots
after resolving special paths so symlinked roots use canonical runtime
paths
- add a protocol regression test for a symlinked writable root with a
denied child and update protocol expectations to canonicalized effective
paths
- update macOS seatbelt tests to assert against effective normalized
roots produced by the shared policy helpers

- cargo test -p codex-protocol
- cargo test -p codex-core explicit_unreadable_paths_are_excluded_
- cargo clippy -p codex-protocol -p codex-core --tests -- -D warnings

bubblewrap described in #14672.
